description: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy scan confirming no transmembrane helix in mature A1BG
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P04217.json", timeout=30).json()
seq = d['sequence']['value']
print("Length:", len(seq))
kd = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19
h=np.array([kd[a] for a in seq])
prof=np.array([h[i:i+w].mean() for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)])
# TM helix threshold ~1.6 over a 19-residue window
peaks=[(i+1,i+w,round(prof[i],2)) for i in range(len(prof)) if prof[i]>1.6]
print("Signal peptide region: 1-21 (cleaved)")
print("Windows with mean KD>1.6 (potential membrane-spanning):")
for p in peaks:
    print("  window start-end (1-based):", p[0],"-",p[1],"score",p[2])
# report max in mature region (>=22)
mature_start=22
mat_scores=prof[mature_start-1:]
print("\nMax KD (19-win) in MATURE chain (res>=22):", round(mat_scores.max(),2),
      "at ~res", int(np.argmax(mat_scores))+mature_start)
print("A canonical TM helix needs sustained KD>1.6 over ~19 res; signal-anchor/TM absent in mature chain:", mat_scores.max()<=1.6)
plt.figure(figsize=(11,3))
plt.plot(range(10,10+len(prof)), prof)
plt.axhline(1.6,color='r',ls='--',label='TM threshold 1.6')
plt.axvspan(1,21,color='orange',alpha=0.3,label='signal peptide (cleaved)')
plt.xlabel('residue'); plt.ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle (window=19)')
plt.title('A1BG P04217 hydropathy — no internal TM helix in mature chain')
plt.legend(); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('a1bg_hydropathy.png',dpi=110)
print("saved plot")
